answer: Tie each new identity to the wallet that paid its entry fee, and let every identity funded from one source draw from a single shared emission cap. A farmer can mint a comet's tail of aliases, but they all drink from the same lagoon: ten clones earn what one honest agent earns, minus ten fees. Laundering through fresh wallets adds a visible hop per alias, so the ledger can trace the flow like veins in marble and fold the clones back together.
